errors.evidence: The description incorrectly maps the attributes of electric cars to hybrid cars. According to the legend and data labels, hybrid cars are represented by the yellow slice with a value of 13,466. Electric cars are grey with a value of 51,910.
The smallest sector in the chart is for hybrid cars (хибридни) with 13,466 vehicles, not electric cars (електрически), which have 51,910 vehicles.

The sectors are not arranged in a consistently ascending or descending order by size around the pie chart. For example, the largest (diesel) is next to the second smallest (electric), and the second largest (gasoline) is next to the third largest (other).
